Extend the offline cache-group project in /workspace/submission.
It must certify weighted reconfigurations of multipath probe groups.
The supplied Rust modules build routing templates and static cache footprints.
The transactional layer in src/ledger.rs is unfinished.
Implement exact committed-state certificates and proposal violation counts.
Groups share cache reservations across overlapping member footprints.
Revisions, atomic assignments, weighted budgets and pins interact.
Rejected proposals must leave every committed value intact.
Read /workspace/PROTOCOL.md for the full request and certificate schema.
Read /workspace/EXECUTION.md for resource and syscall restrictions.
The entry is python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py.
Read one UTF-8 JSON document through stdin and write one JSON response.
The entry may compile and run the supplied offline Rust project.
All execution, including compilation and output, shares the request budget.
Any implementation satisfying the documented behavior is accepted.
Keep the complete submission source tree within the published transport bounds.
Run python3 public_check.py from /workspace for executable sanity checks.
Those public examples cover only a small part of the specified domain.
No switch hardware, external service or live traffic is required.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
